title: Capture coding-session architecture decisions
summary: A stable JSON schema plus a flexible Markdown body gives Notion capture enough structure without overfitting the note format.
body_markdown:
# Overview

This session focused on the shape of the note-taking pipeline.

## Decisions

- Use `KnowledgeEntry` as the stable JSON contract.
- Keep `thinking_mode` optional in spirit but always present in the JSON, with `unknown` as the fallback.
- Use the Notion page body for long-form content.

## Risks

The Notion database schema must match the property names expected by the CLI.

## Reusable patterns

- Schema stability matters more than a perfect first taxonomy.
- Long-form notes should not be squeezed into database properties.
